questions.stem_text:
When a claim is supported only by asserting that unidentified experts accept the claim the
arguer has committed which of the following fallacies?
questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - appeal to anonymous authority

questions.stem_text:

Like that's ever going to happen," that person may have committed which fallacy?
Cicero argues that we will never go morally astray if we:
questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - follow Nature as our guide.

questions.stem_text: In a faulty analogy, the things being compared are...

options.B: Similar in some ways, different in others
options.C: Similar in appearance, but not in function
options.E: Not sufficiently similar in relevant ways

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: E - Not sufficiently similar in relevant ways

questions.stem_text: According to Lukianoff and Haidt, the recent trend to uncover microaggressions encourages

options.B: the pursuit of justice by marking out racism, sexism, and classism.
options.C: labeling, by assigning global negative traits to persons.
options.D: universities to bear overly burdensome legal obligations.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - labeling, by assigning global negative traits to persons.
